title: ID0448628-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / S1 170003220] Charger not working
description:
Reported behavior/issue:  The left side of our charging station is not working, it shows a
error. Charging has been canceled. Right side still works.
Solution: Reboot EcOG

additional_info.subject: ID0448628-DC/Si-D/DE- [MP / S1 170003220] Charger not working CRM:02832000409
additional_info.body:
Hello Bartosz, good morning. I hope you are doing well today.
I checked the charger and it seems like it got stuck in the charging session due to a communication error. I restarted the charging controller instead of a full reboot and now it's working again.
I will keep this ticket open until Friday, if the error reappears, please let me know as soon as possible.
I will also try to proactively check everyday for the error.
If it reappears, I will prepare troubleshooting steps and solution for the Field service team.
If the error doesn't reappear, then I will close the ticket.
Let me know your thought and questions.
Thank you and have a great day.
Best regards,
Francisco
